lines.t: Come Closer Now
What fills the earth when many shield my light?
I send my voice through servants, through lives the world despised.
I gave my spirit freely, still cries for justice never dies.
Do you feel the weight of decay?
Do you taste what fills the air?
This is what I carry daily, my love
This is what I bear
See with me
Let me show you why I grieve
This is not sudden fury
It's the truth that won't leave
I don't judge by rule or range
Nor by moment or move
I judge because I see it all
And now so do you
I came myself
I wore their wounds
I let my blood be spilled
I opened my seat
Without restraint
Wishing hearts would yield
I waited while my servants fell
Under cruelty's hand
Yet violence learned new names
And called itself the plan
Tell me, child, do you see it now?
No failure, but refusal grown
Not weakness, but a madness
That insists on standing alone
See with me
This is not impulse or distinct
I see the hand, I see the heart
I see what caused the pain
Wrath is not the start of this
It's the end of all delay
When light is finally answered by those who turned away
I watched the helpless learn to pray with no one left to hear
I watched the strong refine their lies
Until they felt sincere
I waited longer than you know
Held mercy past its breath
But love that will not guard the weak
Becomes a partner to death
Stay with me
Don't turn from what is true
I don't need approval, child
Only trust me as you view
I am slow, I am precise
I am faithful through and through
What I do, I do with self
And now I'm sharing it with you
The whole earth has become violent and poisoned by greed
Your heart will beat with mine, as you see with me
We'll see you next time.
Thank you.
